caveats: Not representative yet: every yokai except the Kitsune and the Tanuki fights as a Kitsune stand-in (node-scenes.json fallback_fighter), so the Oni's own normals (in data/moves) and the Kappa are not played yet; the apprentice's half damage (Y4, YOK-156) is applied; the bot never takes the dojo trial (YOK-98) and shops only when its config says so (the default newcomer heals at the merchant and rests at the dojo, R4's line), and fight time excludes menus (run length adds menu_seconds_per_node per node).
